provider.name: Polymarket
provider.jurisdictionNote: Read-only public market data only. No wallet, authentication, deposits or order endpoints. Australia is close-only for Polymarket order placement.

methodology.interpretation: Prices are crowd-implied probabilities of each central-bank rate outcome, not forecasts or trade recommendations.
methodology.price: YES bid-ask midpoint when the spread is <=10 points, else last trade, else the Gamma outcome price.
methodology.history: One snapshot per UTC day is retained for up to 90 days; new banks start with short histories that fill in daily.
methodology.jurisdiction: Read-only public market data. No wallet, authentication, deposits or order endpoints.
